builds.hypothesis: R3 is400+0.9 AP magic. Armor scales E/W, not R; AP/MR penetration directly support impact. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification; Void supplies40% MR penetration; Banshee/Zhonya supply105 AP each; Riftmaker supplies HP-to-AP and verified8% combat ramp.

builds.name: Ground Slam: armor-to-damage hybrid
builds.summary: Explore a large Ground Slam armor and AP hit number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large Ground Slam armor and AP hit number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E is 200 + 0.4 total armor + 0.6 AP magic damage. Zhonya combines armor and AP; Frozen Heart and Thornmail test armor slots against pure AP, while Deathcap multiplies the AP portion. Void and Shadowflame are magic penetration because armor scaling does not change the damage type to physical. Frozen Heart mana is incidental rather than direct E damage.
